source.notes: arch-029 (A8 transition breadth). Gated DeltaProduct: per token, head-scalar decay h ← h·exp(g_t), then R ordered Householder delta factors h ← h + (v_tj − hᵀk_tj)·β_tj ⊗ k_tj (each retrieving from the state the previous factor produced), read o_t = (scale·q_t)ᵀ·h after update. The within-token transition is the ORDERED PRODUCT of R deltas — the typed LinearDeltaSpec with num_deltas=R; k/v/beta carry R factors per token (T*R time axis). Verified against fla/ops/gated_delta_product/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/gated_delta_product.py.
